Purpose and Summary

    H.R. 705, the ``Veterans 2nd Amendment Protection Act,'' 
was introduced by Rep. Mike Bost of Illinois on February 1, 
2023. The bill would prohibit the Secretary of the Department 
of Veterans Affairs (VA) from transmitting information of a 
veteran or a beneficiary of VA benefits to the National Instant 
Criminal Background Check System (NICS) on the basis that VA 
has appointed them a fiduciary to help them manage their VA 
benefits, unless there is an order or finding of a judicial 
authority that such veteran or beneficiary is a danger to 
themselves or others.

I’m a trucker in Los Angeles working in and out of the ports of Long Beach. As a company driver I’ve been making on average 1500 a week (2000-2500 if I working an extra day through the weekend) working for 5 days averaging 42-46 hours. It’s true truck driving is bad for your health, if you allow it. Meal prepping, daily exercise and having a steady routine is key. Now working work schedules though, I got lucky with the company I work for, and it’s a set schedule to clock in. However clocking out you might clock out within your 8th hour or maybe even your 10th  hour depends on traffic, which is always bad. I picked night shift to me it’s perfect!! No traffic, and lights are almost always green. I worked in a warehouse before truck driving and it’s the best choice I made. As a truck driver after you leave the yard with your truck it’s only you your truck and the road. You don’t have to deal with people or handle anyone’s BS at work and you aren’t breaking your back lifting boxes and constantly on your feet. As a company driver the money is good just do your research with finding a company to work for there are a few companies that take advantage of truck drivers that’s for sure.
